text:
anish: Product onboarded a vuln-triage subteam; they want a permanent 'vuln-triage' reader role instead of JIT.

maria: what's the exact scope? full raw logs or filtered views?

anish: initial ask was \"all prod security events, 365d\". We should limit indices and redact PII. Also they want periodic SIEM exports to a contractor workspace.

leo: proposal: role 'siem:vuln_reader' -> read on idx_security_* and idx_auth_*; explicitly deny fields: user_email, ip_full, session_token. Exports must be CMK-wrapped and timeboxed.

arjun: contractor access requires KMS controls + contract check. Confirm contract 1234A allows exports with redaction?

anish: contract 1234A permits but mandates field redaction + full audit trail.

maria: retention is the blocker: security default 90d. Can we offer a 180d carveout for vuln work, and provide IR on-call elevation to 365d during incidents?

leo: implement pseudonymization for IP/email: store sha256(ip), email_domain only. That reduces data exposure.

arjun: KMS: exports encrypted with alias/exports-cmk. Note: rotation/disabling CMK can break access to older exports. Need documented unwrap procedure and rotation policy in ticket.

anish: IR asks for immediate access to extended window during incidents. Can we have an OPA-based elevation flow (8h) that writes an immutable audit entry (GRANT_ID, who, why)?

maria: draft policy snippet:
```
allow {
  input.principal == \"role:siem:vuln_reader\"
  input.action == \"read\"
  input.index =~ \"^idx_(security|auth)_\"
  not input.field =~ \"(user_email|ip_full|session_token)\"
}
```

tasha: exports constraints: export.wrap_with_cmk == true, export.ttl <= 14d unless legal approves. Partner exports via approved SFTP endpoint only.

leo: monitoring: alert if principal reads >100k events/day or exports >10GB/day -> auto secops review.

maria: audit logging: emit Kinesis event + write to audit-log index with principal, indices_read, time_range, query_hash, justification_tag, GRANT_ID(if elevated).

arjun: add ops unwrap example for ticket:
```
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://export.bundle.enc --key-id alias/exports-cmk --output text --query Plaintext | base64 --decode > export.tar
```

anish: I'll open SEC-CHANGE-2156. Ticket should include: RBAC YAML, CMK ARNs + rotation policy, retention carveout justification, pseudonymization rules, IR elevation flow, monitoring thresholds.

tasha: drafting RBAC YAML and pseudonymization lambda. sample RBAC binding in ticket.
auditbot: reminder: permanent role changes need a 7-day review window per SEC-ROLE-2023.

anish: noted. Assigning to @maria @tasha. ETA EOD tomorrow. Thanks :thumbsup:
